item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Mindset. Your calendar is full of good prompts: check whether you're projecting or mind reading, ask whether this moment supports the life you're building, break negative patterns with grace. Prompts only work if you stop and answer them. Don't just read them and move on. When one comes up today, pause, name the thought you're having, and ask if it's a fact or a story. Then choose your response. Action: at midday, answer that one question out loud.
